mapper.select: INSERT INTO model_request_quotas (user_public_id, quota_date, used_count, limit_count) VALUES (#{userPublicId}, #{quotaDate,jdbcType=DATE}, 1, #{dailyLimit}) ON CONFLICT (user_public_id, quota_date) DO UPDATE SET used_count = model_request_quotas.used_count + 1, updated_at = now() WHERE model_request_quotas.used_count < model_request_quotas.limit_count RETURNING used_count, limit_count
